Overview

Farmatech HQ is a modern industrial and administrative  complex located in the Kashar industrial zone (7 km, Tirana–Durrës highway),one of the main logistical corridors of Tirana. The facility is designed as amultifunctional structure that combines storage spaces, administrative offices,and areas for technological development and innovation. Its strategic locationnear major roads and the railway line makes the building suitable for businessand logistical activities.

Key Technical Data

  • Land Area: 3,000 m²
  • Built Area Above Ground: 5,880 m²
  • Underground Parking: 1,500 m²
  • Number of Floors: 4 floors above ground + 1 underground floor

Organization of the Facility

The ground floor (1,380 m²) includes the reception area anda logistics warehouse of around 1,000 m² with two industrial doors. The heightis 6 m, and the load-bearing capacity of the floor reaches 2 tons/m².
The first floor (1,500 m²) has a height of 5 m and issuitable for laboratories, technical areas, and light manufacturing.
The second and third floors (1,500 m² each) are designed foradministrative offices, training areas, research laboratories, and aninnovation hub.

Constructive Features

The structure is made from monolithic reinforcedconcrete with C50 concrete and a column grid every 9 m, creating large flexiblespaces. The industrial floors are treated with Concrete Guard Lithium WP2Antibacterial for resistance and antibacterial protection. This treatment usessilver ion technology, which helps eliminate and prevent the proliferation ofbacteria and microorganisms.
Laboratory tests according to European standards ISO 22196:2011 and UNI11021:2002 have shown a reduction in bacterial load of over 99% within 24hours. In addition to hygienic protection, the treatment penetrates theconcrete structure, making the surface stronger, more resistant to wear, water,and chemicals while preserving the natural breathability of the material.
The facade is a facciavista concrete with a base layer of Nanofix, ahigh-penetration nano-emulsion fixative that stabilizes the surface, equalizesabsorption, and improves adhesion of the final layers. The final layer,Thermo-Gum, is a nanostructured thermal reflective and elastomeric paint,reinforced with Aerogel and infrared reflective pigments.
This technology reflects solar radiation, improves thermal insulation, andhelps reduce facade temperature and energy consumption for air conditioning.The system also offers water repellency, resistance to algae, and highdurability in atmospheric conditions, maintaining the aesthetics and long-termprotection of the building.

Elevators

The building is equipped with two modern Oronaelevators designed for performance, comfort, and safety. The wide cabin isfinished with premium materials such as stainless steel and Neocompact Texture.The main elevator of the SMART+ S16 series has a capacity of 1600 kg or 21persons and a speed of 1 m/s, providing sustainable transport for a larger flowof users. The second elevator, SMART S15, has a capacity of 630 kg or 8 personsand a speed of 1.6 m/s, ideal for fast movement between 5 floors. Bothelevators use electric motors with electronic control, energy-efficient LEDlighting, with automatic shut-off to reduce energy consumption, safety systemswith photoelectric barriers, GSM telealarm, and emergency evacuation. They meetthe European standards EN 81-20/50 and provide direct access even with parkingon the −1 floor.

Advanced Glass

The building is equipped with advanced Guardian ClimaGuardSolar glass, designed for energy efficiency and maximum comfort. The systemconsists of triple glazing with a selective layer and an argon gas space, whichimproves thermal insulation and reduces energy loss. The glass allows about 66%of natural light while controlling solar energy transmission to reduceoverheating in the summer. With a thermal value of Ug around 1.0 W/m²K, itcontributes to high insulation and energy efficiency. It also provides acousticinsulation of up to 37 dB, reducing external noise and creating a quieter andmore comfortable work environment.

The building includes a dedicated underground parking level with a total surface area of approximately 1,500 square meters, designed to provide convenient and secure access for employees, visitors, and operational vehicles.
The parking area is directly connected to the main building via the vertical circulation system, including elevators that serve all floors of the facility. This ensures smooth movement between the parking level and the administrative and operational spaces above.
The space has been designed with wide circulation lanes and optimized parking layouts, allowing efficient vehicle movement and comfortable parking.

In addition, the structure incorporates technical infrastructure for rainwater collection and drainage, supporting the building's sustainable management.
This underground parking facility supports the daily operations of Farmatech Headquarters while ensuring accessibility, safety, and functionality for all users. 
This building combines innovation, technology, and functionality.
